name: Visual-novel moe CG
summary: A polished still illustration like a galge event CG: huge glossy layered eyes, soft gradient cel shading, pastel palette and dreamy sun-washed backgrounds.

traits.line: Thin, clean digital lines, often tinted toward the fill colour; fine hair-strand lines.
traits.shading: Two- to three-tone cel shading softened by airbrush gradients; glossy hair highlight band; pink blush hatching under the eyes.
traits.palette: Pastel, high key: sky blue, cream, pink, pale yellow; sunset orange for emotional scenes.
traits.lighting: Soft backlight, glow, bloom, sunbeams, dreamy haze.
traits.faces: Very large eyes with layered gradient irises and prominent white highlights, tiny nose and mouth, rounded chin, slightly large head, long hair.
traits.backgrounds: Painted or photo-traced nostalgic town and school scenery, slightly blurred behind the figure; snow, summer sky, blossom.
traits.texture: Clean digital painting with glow overlays; no grain.
traits.camera: Static still-illustration composition; centred figure; event-CG framing.

style_words: Japanese visual-novel event CG illustration: thin clean tinted lineart, soft two-tone cel shading blended with airbrush gradients, glossy layered highlights and pink blush hatching, pastel high-key palette of sky blue, cream and pink, dreamy backlight bloom and haze, softly blurred nostalgic painted backgrounds, as in Kanon (1999) and Clannad (2004).

krea2.style: Japanese visual-novel event CG illustration, as in Clannad: thin clean lineart tinted toward the fill colours, soft two-tone shading blended with airbrush gradients, glossy layered highlights, pink blush hatching, very large layered eyes, modest fully clothed figures, pastel high-key sky blue, cream and pink, backlight glow and haze, blurred backgrounds.
krea2.recap: Rendered throughout as a Japanese visual-novel event CG illustration with soft airbrushed shading.

flux3_klein.style: Japanese visual-novel event CG illustration in the register of Clannad: thin clean lineart tinted toward each fill colour, fine hair-strand lines, very large eyes with layered gradient irises and bright white highlights, tiny nose and mouth, rounded chin, figures fully clothed in their stated garments, soft two-tone cel shading blended with airbrush gradients, a glossy highlight band on the hair, pink blush hatching under the eyes, soft backlight with bloom and haze, softly blurred painted backgrounds, a clean digital painting finish.
flux3_klein.recap: Sky blue and cream fill the sky and the walls, pale yellow and pink fill the ground, sunset orange appears only in the light sources, the shadow fills are a soft lavender tint, and every garment keeps its own stated colour.

qwen_image_2_1.style: The image is a Japanese visual-novel event CG illustration in a signature Kanon style, with thin, clean lineart tinted toward the fill colour, fine hair-strand lines, soft two-tone cel shading blended with airbrush gradients, glossy layered highlights, pink blush hatching on the cheeks, dreamy backlight bloom and haze, and softly blurred painted surroundings, depicting a scene from a Gothic Victorian novel in a palette of pastel high-key sky blue, cream, pink and pale yellow, with warm sunset orange.
qwen_image_2_1.recap: The overall composition presents its focal subject as a still illustrated moment against softly blurred surroundings, in a dreamy, nostalgic mood, keeps to a palette of pastel high-key sky blue, cream, pink and pale yellow, with warm sunset orange, and reads throughout as a Japanese visual-novel event CG illustration in a signature Kanon style, with thin, clean lineart tinted toward the fill colour, fine hair-strand lines, soft two-tone cel shading blended with airbrush gradients, glossy layered highlights, pink blush hatching on the cheeks, dreamy backlight bloom and haze, and softly blurred painted surroundings.
